up: Retrieve all distinct molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123890. Return the columns chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), compound_name (from compound_records), and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890'. Only include rows where canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_records to compound_structures on molregno. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
